title: Exercise Northstar: D-Day
description: The exercise is live — and commanders are staring at 20-minute-old positions.
storyContext: Exercise live, 3,000 in the field. The radio crackles: "Command, my screen shows Alpha Company at their old position. They moved 20 minutes ago." In a real operation, stale data gets people hurt.

callbacks.arc2-ch1:micro-batch: Your 5-second batching kept the display so clean that everyone trusted the screen completely. That trust is exactly the problem now.

software-engineer.title: Find the Stale Data
software-engineer.instruction: Positions are 20 minutes old. Trace where data gets stuck, field to screen.
software-engineer.hint: Data jams at the source, in transit, in storage, or on screen.

items.label: Confirm field devices are sending fresh updates
Check if updates pile up in transit
Check if stale saved answers get shown
Verify the live connection pushes to screens
Deploy the fix, confirm fresh data flows

software-engineer.consequenceSuccess: Found it — updates jammed mid-route. Twenty minutes later, dots move in real time and the radios go quiet.
software-engineer.consequenceFail: You start at the screen and work backwards — an hour lost. The jam was near the source.

data-scientist.title: Help Commanders Decide Now
data-scientist.instruction: Engineers are fixing the flow. Commanders need a usable picture now. What do you give them?
data-scientist.hint: Confident guess, trusted radio, honest uncertainty, or another source?

options.label: Estimate each unit's spot from its last speed and direction. Surprisingly accurate for short gaps.
options.consequence: Your predicted dots land within 100 metres of reality. Maths quietly saves the morning.

options.label: Units call in positions by radio every 5 minutes. Old school, but 100% true.
options.consequence: Radios crackle every five minutes. Slower, noisier — and every position is true. Old school delivers.

options.label: Show old positions with a growing 'staleness ring' around each dot. Honest — maybe paralysing.
options.consequence: Rings grow around every dot. Commanders finally see what the screen doesn't know. A few freeze up.

options.label: Live drone cameras — commanders literally see units. Perfect until clouds roll in.
options.consequence: Live drone footage — commanders love it. Then a cloud bank rolls over the western sector. Uh oh.

cloud-engineer.title: Rebuild the Data Pipeline
cloud-engineer.instruction: Rebuild the route: data arrives, gets processed, gets delivered.

items.label: Field Receiver — collects incoming field data
Old Data Cleaner — flags stale data
Live Relay — pushes fresh data to screens
Failed Message Store — holds undelivered updates
System Watcher — alerts when stages stop

cloud-engineer.consequenceSuccess: Data flows clean, field to screen in seconds. The ops room actually applauds.
cloud-engineer.consequenceFail: One stage out of place and updates loop endlessly — the screen shows yesterday. Re-trace the flow.
